status: Frozen before numerical execution; do not tune support floors or success criteria from results
purpose: Test whether prediction resource headroom relies on a known positive lower relaxation rate
scope: Conditional prior-sensitivity screen on existing synthetic development observations, not a new algorithm or independent replication
normalization: Known G(0)=1, unknown nonnegative equilibrium mass; zero-rate mass is merged observationally with equilibrium
outer_grid: Keep original 96 cells on [0.02,4] unchanged; add 16 cells per lower decade and one [0,0.00002] cell at floor zero
inner_grid: Keep original 193 rates unchanged; add 32 rates per lower decade; floor zero has no duplicate equilibrium atom
reuse: All 16 original pilots and saved future observations at resource indices 0 and 6; no new noise or truth generated

gate.criterion: At floor zero, all 16 long-window outer scores are <=1 and at least two truth groups including continuous_uniform have long-window mean outer score <=0.8 times the matched floor-zero short-window mean inner score
gate.retention_check: For each truth, floor-zero long-window mean outer score <=1.25 times original-support long-window mean inner score; report separately from resource utility

validation: Reproduce both horizons' original-support inner/outer bounds and realized posterior intervals
Verify nested original rates/cells remain present at every support floor
Pair diameters cannot shrink and realized intervals cannot contract as the spectral support expands
Inner diameters <= outer diameters and realized posterior widths <= outer pair bounds
All supported simulated targets remain contained
Replay all saved primal/dual LP evidence without optimization
Check zero-rate and small-rate responses and endpoint curvature envelopes with independent time quadrature
limitations: Upper rate bound 4, positive spectrum, exact G(0), linear hereditary operator and exact known noise remain assumed
No support beyond rate 4 or signed/nonlinear kernels are covered
All observations are reused development data; no new ultra-slow truth or external material validation
Prediction interval utility does not imply full-kernel or equilibrium identifiability
Floating-point primal/dual checks do not provide outward-rounded certificates
Relaxing a prior within established set-membership inference does not itself establish novelty
